sourcing: Every price, SKU, option list and image below was pulled from the brand's own public Shopify feed on 2026-09-26. Products the user listed that could not be verified (blocked sites, or names that do not exist as listed) were replaced with a same-type product from a brand feed that answers, and each replacement is named in the notes.

products.name: Vet's Best Dental Care Finger Wipes
products.description: Finger wipes for dog dental care from Vet's Best, rubbed along the teeth and gums as a routine clean. The finger format suits owners who find a full toothbrush awkward to handle.
products.image_alt: Vet's Best dental care finger wipes pack
products.notes: Chosen variant 'Default Title', USD 17.11, store SKU 31658000012. Kept as the user's Vet's Best Dental Care Finger Wipes.

products.name: TropiClean Fresh Breath Clean Teeth Dental Oral Care Gel
products.description: A no-brushing dental gel for dogs from TropiClean's Fresh Breath line, applied to the teeth and gums. The 4 oz tube is the standard size, and the range also comes in 2 oz, puppy and 3 pack versions.
products.image_alt: TropiClean Fresh Breath clean teeth dental oral care gel 4 oz tube
products.notes: Chosen variant 'Default Title', USD 19.99, store SKU FBCTGL4Z-WIP. Kept as the user's TropiClean Fresh Breath Dental Gel.

products.name: VetIQ Multivitamin
products.description: A daily multivitamin supplement from VetIQ, sold as a bottle of soft chews. It is a general supplement rather than a targeted remedy, aimed at covering everyday diet gaps.
products.notes: Chosen variant 'Default Title', USD 18.99, store SKU 100107. Kept as the user's VetIQ Multivitamin Supplement. The store image file name shows 90ct, but the variant publishes no size option.

products.name: NaturVet Omega-Gold Skin & Coat Soft Chews
products.description: Omega-3 soft chews for dogs and cats from NaturVet's Omega-Gold line, in 90 and 180 count bags. They are a skin and coat supplement given as a daily chew.
products.image_alt: NaturVet Omega-Gold skin and coat soft chews 90 count bag
products.notes: Chosen variant '90 ct', USD 21.99, store SKU 79903692. Store options: 90 ct; 180 ct. Full store price range 21.99-37.99. Kept as the user's NaturVet Omega-Gold Soft Chews. The published pack shot is over 4 MB, so the localizer stores the same photo at width=1200.

products.name: NaturVet Hip & Joint Soft Chews
products.description: A hip and joint soft chew supplement from NaturVet in a 120 count bag. It sits alongside the brand's Hip & Joint Plus and Cat Hip & Joint chews, all aimed at mobility support.
products.image_alt: NaturVet Hip and Joint soft chews 120 count bag
products.notes: Chosen variant '120 ct', USD 23.99, store SKU 79903580. Store options: 120 ct. Substitute for Nutri-Vet Hip & Joint Soft Chews; nutrivet.com intermittently fails TLS and its catalogue could not be verified.

products.name: NaturVet Dental Targeted Care Soft Chews
products.description: Dental chews for dogs and cats from NaturVet's Targeted Care line, in a 60 count bag. They are a daily dental chew, sold alongside the brand's separate PlaqueOff dental bones.
products.image_alt: NaturVet dental targeted care soft chews for dogs and cats
products.notes: Chosen variant '60 ct', USD 19.97, store SKU 760-00866. Store options: 60 ct. Substitute for KONG Dental Stick; no KONG dental stick is published in their site or BigCommerce data.

products.name: tuft + paw THE BALM Paw & Nose Moisturizing Balm
products.description: A paw and nose moisturising balm from tuft + paw's Pride + Groom line, for dogs and cats. It is aimed at dry or cracked paw pads and noses rather than at the coat itself.
products.image_alt: tuft + paw Pride and Groom The Balm paw and nose moisturising balm jar
products.notes: Chosen variant 'Default Title', USD 23.00, store SKU PG-BALM. Substitute for Burt's Bees Paw & Nose Lotion; burtsbees.com exposes no readable product feed from this host.

products.name: Vet's Best Ear Relief Finger Wipes
products.description: Ear relief finger wipes from Vet's Best, in the same finger-wipe format as the brand's dental wipes. They are sold for routine ear cleaning alongside Vet's Best ear washes.
products.image_alt: Vet's Best ear relief finger wipes pack
products.notes: Chosen variant 'Default Title', USD 18.25, store SKU 31658000005. Substitute for Pet MD Chlorhexidine Wipes; petmd.com publishes no product sitemap and its /shop path returns 404 from this host.

products.name: Vet's Best Enzymatic Dog Toothpaste
products.description: An enzymatic dog toothpaste from Vet's Best, sold in its Clean Teeth line. It is a no-brushing option that sits alongside the brand's dental chews and finger wipes.
products.image_alt: Vet's Best enzymatic dog toothpaste tube
products.notes: Chosen variant 'Default Title', USD 9.53, store SKU 3165810096. Substitute for Virbac C.E.T. Enzymatic Toothpaste; virbac.com's sitemap exposes no priced product pages from this host. Same enzymatic toothpaste type.
